edge.scene: Site timezone for today's statistics and historical recomputation
edge.trigger: Two operators whose browsers or operating systems have different timezones view the same day
edge.expect: Use the same site timezone and day interval. The metric definition does not change with viewer location. Charts and exports label the site timezone.
